name: Reverse Translation Baseline Audit Correction

reasonForCorrection.correction: Invertibility must be audited from the canonical individual rule records under spec/fa-ir/rules/records, not from the materialization manifest.

brailleCellInvertibility.note: A cell collision is not automatically an unrecoverable ambiguity. Mode indicators, context, sequence structure, and parser state may disambiguate some collisions. This report identifies where a naive cell-to-print lookup is insufficient.

phase13_1bRequiredWork: Freeze the canonical reverse derivation source as the 176 individual forward rule records plus their 176 conformance records/profile inventory.
Classify every rule into reverse categories without treating cell collisions as automatically fatal.
Define parser state for numeric mode, Latin mode, context rules, indicators, sequences, layout, and normalization.
Define ambiguity semantics for cases that remain ambiguous after state/context resolution.
Freeze reverse SDK result/error/API contracts before implementing the engine.
Create independent reverse conformance vectors and explicit round-trip properties; do not merely swap forward vectors.
